Generic.Int64.name: Generic.Int64
Generic.Int64.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

Generic.JSON.name: Generic.JSON
Generic.JSON.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

Identity.UUID.name: Identity.UUID
Identity.UUID.description: UUID v4 with automatic base62 encoding for client-facing APIs

Temporal.DateTime.name: Temporal.DateTime
Temporal.DateTime.description: ISO8601 datetime string. Epoch wire values keep this scalar and declare x-temporal-format (unix, unix_millis, unix_micros, unix_nanos) on the property; the unit is never guessed from digit count.

Review.name: Review
Review.comment:
A review's conversation of refs and code blocks alone, its bodies at
most 2000 code points, pinned and resolved by the permissions it names.

ReviewCommentsConversations.name: ReviewCommentsConversations
ReviewCommentsConversations.comment: On a table, one row per row that has had a message, kept for the table as a whole: the greatest message id, reaction number and stand the row's conversation has given. Every write of a conversation moves its row's version, which holds two writes of one conversation apart; a delete of the row leaves it, so a row re-created with the key numbers on from it and never reuses an id.

fields.name: conversation
fields.description: The key of the row whose conversation it is.

fields.name: lastMessage
fields.description: The greatest message id the conversation has given.

fields.name: lastReaction
fields.description: The greatest reaction number the conversation has given.

fields.name: lastStand
fields.description: The greatest stand the conversation has given.

ReviewCommentsDeliveries.name: ReviewCommentsDeliveries
ReviewCommentsDeliveries.comment: On a table, one row per message and subject that should hear of it, keyed by the message and the subject: each subject a message that comes to stand mentions and each follower of its thread but its author, and each subject an edit adds a mention of. A notifier or an agent dispatcher outside the core claims and settles them with claimDeliveries and settleDeliveries; the core sends nothing. The inbox reads its mentions from them. A delete or a purge of the message deletes them but the claimed ones, and so does a delete of the row.

fields.name: review
fields.description: The Review row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: delivery
fields.description: The message's id in ten digits zero-padded, a dot, and the subject.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The id of the message.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: The subject that should hear of it, as the mention or the follow gave it.

fields.name: mention
fields.description: Whether a reason is the mention.

fields.name: reply
fields.description: Whether a reason is the follow of its thread.

fields.name: state
fields.description: pending, claimed, failed, sent or dropped.

fields.name: dueAt
fields.description: When it is next due, in epoch milliseconds: at once while pending, the claim's expiry while claimed, the next attempt once failed; absent once sent or dropped.

fields.name: token
fields.description: The claim's token while claimed.

fields.name: claimedBy
fields.description: The subject of the last claimer.

fields.name: attempts
fields.description: The claims it has had.

fields.name: error
fields.description: The last failure's, or the reason it was dropped.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When it was made, or returned to pending by an edit, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: settledAt
fields.description: When it was last settled or dropped, in epoch milliseconds.

ReviewCommentsDrafts.name: ReviewCommentsDrafts
ReviewCommentsDrafts.comment: On a table, one row per chunk a non-empty appendDraft added to a composing message's draft, keyed by the message and the chunk's offset: the draft is its chunks in offset order. A finish, an interrupt, a delete or a purge of the message deletes them, and so does a delete of the row.

fields.name: review
fields.description: The Review row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: chunk
fields.description: The message's id and the chunk's offset, each in ten digits zero-padded, joined by a dot, so the key's order is theirs.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The id of the composing message.

fields.name: chunkOffset
fields.description: The draft's length in code points before the chunk: the offset of its draft signal.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The chunk's text, never empty.

ReviewCommentsEdits.name: ReviewCommentsEdits
ReviewCommentsEdits.comment: On a table, one row per edit of a message, keyed by the message and the edit's number: what the message held before the edit, who made it and when. A delete or a purge of the message deletes them, and so does a delete of the row.

fields.name: review
fields.description: The Review row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: edit
fields.description: The message's id and the edit's number on it, each in ten digits zero-padded, joined by a dot, so the key's order is theirs.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The id of the message edited.

fields.name: number
fields.description: The edit's number on the message, from 1.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The body before the edit.

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: The blocks before the edit.

fields.name: mentions
fields.description: The mentions before the edit.

fields.name: by
fields.description: The subject of the caller who made the edit.

fields.name: forSubject
fields.description: The subject the editor acted for, when the caller acted for someone (D77).

fields.name: at
fields.description: When, in epoch milliseconds.

ReviewCommentsFollows.name: ReviewCommentsFollows
ReviewCommentsFollows.comment: On a table, one row per subject and thread it has state on, keyed by the thread and the subject: whether it follows the thread, and its read marker on the thread's replies. A message that stands makes its author follow its thread, and its mentions too, but not a role:<name>; follow sets it, and markRead with a thread moves its marker. A purge of the thread, and a delete of the row, deletes them.

fields.name: review
fields.description: The Review row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: follow
fields.description: The thread's id in ten digits zero-padded, a dot, and the subject.

fields.name: thread
fields.description: The id of the thread's top-level message.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: The follower's subject.

fields.name: followed
fields.description: Whether the subject follows the thread.

fields.name: readUpTo
fields.description: The subject's marker on the thread's replies: a stand.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When it last changed, in epoch milliseconds.

ReviewCommentsMessages.name: ReviewCommentsMessages
ReviewCommentsMessages.comment: On a table, one row per message of the row's conversation, keyed by its id: its thread and the message it quotes, its author, its state, its body, blocks and mentions, when it was posted and last edited, how many edits it has had, whether it is pinned, the clientId it was posted with, and for a top-level message who resolved its thread and when. A deleted message keeps its row; a purged one loses it. A delete of the row deletes them.

fields.name: review
fields.description: The Review row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The message's id on the row, from 1, in ten digits zero-padded so the key's order is theirs; never reused, a purged message's included.

fields.name: thread
fields.description: For a reply, the id of its thread's top-level message; absent for a top-level message.

fields.name: quotes
fields.description: The id of the message of the thread a reply quotes, when it quotes one.

fields.name: author
fields.description: The subject of the caller who posted or began it.

fields.name: forSubject
fields.description: The subject its author acted for, when the caller acted for someone (D77); absent otherwise. Named so because for is reserved.

fields.name: via
fields.description: The channel kind its author's call came over (D157): sms, email or another a channel adapter names, as a reply or an inbound message runs as its sender; absent for a call over the API.

fields.name: state
fields.description: composing while begun and not finished, posted, interrupted once stopped with what was written, or deleted.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The text, Markdown; empty while composing (the draft's chunks hold it) and once deleted.

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: The blocks as posted or last edited, in order.

fields.name: mentions
fields.description: The subjects it mentions, as posted or last edited, in order.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When it was posted, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: postedAt
fields.description: When it came to stand, in epoch milliseconds: its post's time.

fields.name: stand
fields.description: Its place in the order the conversation's messages came to stand, from 1.

fields.name: editedAt
fields.description: When it was last edited, in epoch milliseconds; absent before its first edit and once deleted.

fields.name: edits
fields.description: How many edits it has had.

fields.name: pinned
fields.description: Whether it is pinned.

fields.name: clientId
fields.description: The caller's key for it, by which a retry of its post returns it.

fields.name: resolvedBy
fields.description: For a top-level message whose thread is resolved, the subject who resolved it.

fields.name: resolvedFor
fields.description: The subject its resolver acted for, when the caller acted for someone (D77).

fields.name: resolvedAt
fields.description: When its thread was resolved, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: draftLength
fields.description: While composing, the draft's length in code points; absent otherwise.

fields.name: lastAppendAt
fields.description: While composing, when its begin or its latest appendDraft ran, in epoch milliseconds; absent otherwise. composeTimeoutMs after it the message is idle, and its deadline interrupts it.

ReviewCommentsReactions.name: ReviewCommentsReactions
ReviewCommentsReactions.comment: On a table, one row per reaction a subject holds on a message, keyed by its number on the row, which orders reactions: the message, the emoji, the subject and when. unreact deletes the caller's; a delete or a purge of the message deletes them, and so does a delete of the row.

fields.name: review
fields.description: The Review row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: reaction
fields.description: The reaction's number on the row, from 1, in ten digits zero-padded: the order reactions were given in, which listReactions pages by.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The id of the message reacted to.

fields.name: emoji
fields.description: The emoji: a name or the character itself.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: The subject of the caller who reacted.

fields.name: forSubject
fields.description: The subject the caller acted for, when it acted for someone (D77).

fields.name: at
fields.description: When, in epoch milliseconds.

ReviewCommentsReads.name: ReviewCommentsReads
ReviewCommentsReads.comment: On a table, one row per subject that has a read marker on the row's conversation, keyed by the subject: the greatest stand of the top-level messages it has read, and when it last moved. markRead and a subject's own top-level message move it, never back. A delete of the row deletes them.

fields.name: review
fields.description: The Review row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: The reader's subject.

fields.name: upTo
fields.description: The conversation marker: a stand.

fields.name: readAt
fields.description: When it last moved, in epoch milliseconds.

Ticket.name: Ticket
Ticket.comment:
A ticket's conversation (D77, D103's step 4): messages and their
replies, edits within 15 minutes of a post, reactions, pins and resolved
threads, each write beside the row, and a caller holding tickets.moderate
edits and deletes another's message and purges.
